plan: DUMMIE PLAN V1 — Cognitive Evolution Operating Layer

claims: Without ranked truth policy, agents overfit recency/availability and can override code facts with narrative artifacts.
P4 metadata is insufficient unless conflict decisions apply effective rank + freshness + safety rejection.
Mirror/chat/report sources must be explicitly non-canonical by default to prevent drift.
objections: High-rank artifacts can still be stale; rank alone is unsafe.
Reports may claim PASS while tests fail.
Vault and notes can preserve outdated claims without freshness checks.
decisions: Adopt explicit truth-source rank ladder with caveats.
Use policy-level effective rank formula with evidence bonus and stale/risk penalties.
Hard reject unsafe artifacts and assign hard zero rank.
Require deterministic tie-breakers and human review fallback.
risks: No runtime enforcement yet; policy can be bypassed until integrated.
Legacy docs may continue injecting low-confidence contradictions.
Freshness instrumentation is incomplete in some artifact families.

snowball_assessment.reason: P5 adds deterministic truth conflict policy over P4 metadata, reducing ambiguity and recency bias without runtime changes.

warnings: Legacy spec debt remains in doc/guides/mcp_server_usage.md.
Policy enforcement is declarative until future runtime integration phases.
